name: count-grid
title: Count Grid
description: A grid of cards rushes in under a horizontal smear, settles on five and a label, then the camera pulls back a fraction while every empty cell around them fills in from the middle out and the number jumps. The "and it scales" shot, without a cut — one card is deliberately late to land, which is what makes the entry read as five separate things arriving rather than one picture being pushed in.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/count-grid?ref=cli — pass cards an array of image URLs and from/to/noun for the label.
